name: geojson_tools
description: Measure and check GeoJSON (RFC 7946) given inline as a Geometry, Feature or FeatureCollection: bounding box, centroid, planar area (exact, in square degrees) and spherical area by spherical excess on a sphere of R = 6371.0088 km (the IUGG mean radius; spherical, not ellipsoidal), perimeter and line length, point-in-polygon with holes and boundary detection, and validation: closed rings of at least four positions, RFC 7946 winding (exterior counter-clockwise, holes clockwise), coordinate ranges, self-intersecting rings and holes outside their exterior.

geojson.description: GeoJSON Geometry, Feature or FeatureCollection, inline

text.description: The same GeoJSON as a JSON string, instead of geojson

radius_km.description: Sphere radius for spherical area, perimeter and length

catalog.source: original; RFC 7946 (The GeoJSON Format, 2016) for structure and winding; spherical excess of great-circle polygons summed per edge, tan(E/2) = tan(Δλ/2)·sin((φ1+φ2)/2)/cos((φ2−φ1)/2) (Napier's analogies; Todhunter, Spherical Trigonometry; as in Wikipedia's 'Spherical trigonometry', from latitude and longitude), on the IUGG mean radius R1 = 6371.0088 km (Moritz, Geodetic Reference System 1980); shoelace area and centroid
